subject: Advanced Auditing I
text: Explain the auditor’s duty in case of fraud? Excellent Bank Ltd. is a Public Limited Company. The said Bank has various branches all over India. The Bank appoints 3 Joint Auditors for the financial year ending on 31/03/2024. All three 3 Joint Auditors divide the work with mutual consent. Verification of Consolidation, however, remained undivided. All branches and zones were divided among the 3 Joint Auditors. During the audit of zones, CA Z, one of the joint auditors, expressed a concern about internal control in one of the large corporate branches situated in his zone. The irregularity was not reported in the final accounts as the other 2 Joint Auditors were not in favor of reporting, and the decision not to report the same was audited by CA Z. The Bank seeks your advice about the responsibility of the 3 Joint Auditors in the above situation. Attempt the following H Limited is an Investment Company preparing its Financial Statements in accordance with Ind AS. The Company obtains funds from various investors and commits to its performance for a fair return and capital appreciation to its investors. During the year under audit, it had been observed that the Company had invested 25% in S1 Ltd., 50% in S2 Ltd., and 60% in S3 Ltd. of the respective share capitals of the Investee Companies. When checking the investment schedule of the Company, an issue arose as to whether there would arise any need to consolidate accounts of any such investee companies with those of H Limited in accordance with section 129(3) of the Companies Act, 2013, which contains no exclusion from consolidation. Analyse the issues involved and give your views. Explain the verification of the sale and purchase of NPA (Non-Performing Assets) Attempt the following What do you mean by audit documentation, and explain the assembly of the final audit file? FAS Insurance Brokers Limited is a leading online insurance intermediary. During the year the Director General of GST Intelligence (DGGI) has issued a notice to the company for allegedly creating fictitious invoices for "marketing and sales services" amounting to %50 crores in favour of non-life insurance companies. The premises of the company were also searched during the year by DGGI officials. The matter was also reported to IRDAI by DGGI for violation of norms and regulations in this regard. Does the above situation have any bearing on your responsibilities as a statutory auditor of the company? Outline briefly in the context of possible non-compliance with laws by the company.
